notes: Note-only correction. The unit for s022 described the article as substantival; it is the second attributive article of τοῦ πατρός μου τοῦ ἐν τοῖς οὐρανοῖς, whose head noun πατρός stands expressed in front of it, and MAT.7.11 s018 describes the identical construction correctly. The alignment is unchanged in every unit, head and status; only that note is rewritten so the two verses describe one construction one way.
